_metadata.description: Calculate and report knowledge quality metrics including coherence, freshness, and redundancy

requirements.title: Coherence score calculation
requirements.description: Calculate semantic coherence within collections by measuring similarity variance and cluster tightness

requirements.title: Freshness score calculation
requirements.description: Track knowledge age using payload timestamps and calculate time-decay based freshness scores

requirements.title: Redundancy detection
requirements.description: Identify duplicate or near-duplicate knowledge entries using similarity thresholds

requirements.title: Quality metrics API endpoint
requirements.description: GET /api/v1/knowledge/health returns aggregated quality metrics for all collections

requirements.title: Quality calculation performance < 1s
requirements.description: Quality metrics calculation must complete in under 1 second per collection scan
